name: Silk and Sabre
source:
One massive explosion. Two sworn enemies. One deserted island.

Welcome to Silk and Sabre, a high-seas erotic adventure set in the lawless 1700s. You are Captain Jack Hawthorne, a silver-tongued English pirate with a taste for rum and a talent for trouble. After a bloody boarding action goes up in flames, you wash up on a tropical purgatory with the last person you expected: Li Shuying, a high-born scholar-daughter of the Imperial Court.

She thinks you’re a filthy barbarian. You think she’s a haughty ice queen. But in this humidity, clothes don't stay on for long... and survival makes for very strange bedfellows. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314350/Silk_and_Sabre/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一场惊天爆炸。两个不共戴天的死敌。一座荒无人烟的孤岛。

欢迎来到《丝绸与弯刀》，一场以法外横行的18世纪为背景的海上情色冒险。你将扮演杰克·霍桑船长，一名能言善道、嗜好朗姆酒且总能惹出麻烦的英国海盗。在一场血腥的跳帮战化作熊熊烈火之后，你被冲上了一座宛如炼狱的热带孤岛，而与你一同流落至此的，偏偏是你最意想不到的人——出身朝廷名门的才女千金李淑英。

在她眼里，你是个肮脏粗鄙的蛮夷；在你眼里，她是个目中无人的冰山美人。但在如此湿热的气候里，衣衫可穿不了太久……而求生的本能，往往会让最水火不容的冤家同床共枕。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314350/Silk_and_Sabre/]Steam[/url]]
